accordion.name: accordion
accordion.description: A named group of collapsible sections, each with a heading and a page content slot. All sections start closed. More than one section can be open at a time.

action-queue.name: action-queue
action-queue.description: The actions and unreadable entries of the offline queue, each with its state as text and its exits. A waiting action shows as pending, never as done. Page code fills it from its queue.

app-shell.description: A top bar, a named side navigation area and a main area. Page code supplies content in the top, side and default slots. At 30rem or narrower, the navigation area moves into a modal drawer.

approval-queue.description: A named list of proposals with unique ids. A change to a proposal or its actor requires a new binding. A pending decision keeps its bound values and key until a receipt or cancel ends it. An approval mark shows a decision. A badge shows other states. A polite status gives each receipt result.

breadcrumbs.name: breadcrumbs

card.name: card

If the author is the message actor, the visible line is shorter and a screen reader reads the full author.

chart.description: An SVG chart with a table view. Categories and series must not be empty. Each series has one value per category. Stacks keep positive and negative totals separate. Arrow keys move through points in series order and wrap at each end. A new fill resets the point and closes the table.

service-status.name: service-status
service-status.description: A strip that shows service states from the application. Hover or focus shows optional details. A polite status announces each change to a service in the previous fill once. The label, group and order of items with the same label and group identify a service.

skeleton.name: skeleton
skeleton.description: A named loading status with one to six lines that hold space for content.

parts.name: details

parts.name: line
parts.description: Visible placeholder line. It is hidden from the accessibility tree.

parts.name: status
parts.description: Status with the accessible name of the loading content.

source-status.name: source-status
source-status.description: The state of an offline data source of the application as text: ready, stale, empty or error.

stack.name: stack
stack.description: A labeled group that puts its child elements in one column or one row.

parts.description: Control and technical details of a refusal.

parts.name: reason

status.name: status
status.description: One state with short text. The application or service gives the state. Pending has warning colors and a dashed border. Passed has success colors and a solid border. Failed has a double border and Unknown has a dotted border. Each state shows its label as text.

steps.name: steps
steps.description: A named ordered list of wizard steps. The current index starts at zero and must be within the list. Each step shows its position and its state as text. A button for a done step sends a mu-step-change event with the index. Page code changes the step and moves focus.

parts.name: back
parts.description: Button that requests a done step.

parts.name: details
parts.description: Control and technical details of a refusal.

parts.name: position
parts.description: Position of the step in the list.

parts.name: state
parts.description: Text that shows Done, Current or Next.

parts.name: step
parts.description: One step in the list, with a mark for the current step.

table.name: table
table.description: Text columns and rows with optional status text. Columns must not be empty. Each row has one cell per column. Each status is in status_values. The sort key is a zero-based column index. Sort direction needs a sort key. Equal cells keep their input order. A new fill resets the sort.

parts.name: authorship
parts.description: Type and ID of the author, with a name when available.

parts.name: details
parts.description: Control and technical details of a refusal.

parts.name: sort-status
parts.description: Text that gives the sort column and direction.

parts.name: table
parts.description: Scroll area that contains the table.

table-row.name: table-row
table-row.description: A row in a table. Cells follow the column order. The optional status is text from the application or the service. The table checks the cell count and the allowed status values.

tabs.name: tabs
tabs.description: A named list of tabs with one selected tab and one page content slot for each panel.

parts.name: details
parts.description: Control and technical details of a refusal.

parts.name: panel
parts.description: Container for page content. The selected tab shows its panel.

parts.name: tablist
parts.description: Named container for the tab buttons.

text.name: text
text.description: A run of text. The kit always shows the value as text, never as markup.

parts.name: reason

text-cell.name: text-cell
text-cell.description: A cell of a data grid with a text value. A cell with no value is empty.

time-field.name: time-field
time-field.description: A labeled native time input with a required value as HH:MM in 24-hour form. The time must exist and stay within the optional limits. The optional step is in minutes from the earliest time, or from 00:00 when there is no earliest time. The default step is one minute.

toggle-field.description: A labeled yes or no field. The switch display adds role="switch" to the same native checkbox and shows On or Off. The value is false if the fill does not give it.

tooltip.name: tooltip
tooltip.description: Short text that gives a control its accessible description. The text shows on hover or focus. Escape hides the text until the pointer enters the target again or focus returns from another element.

upload.name: upload
upload.description: A person picks or drops files. Page code binds the tool and the limits. The control checks each file before the application sends it. A file with no receipt offers Retry and Cancel after the wait limit. Done shows only after a successful receipt. The receipt can show a reference with a copy control.

parts.name: drop
